ambient_events: Your teeth ache faintly, the way they do near the Meltline, and you understand it as a warning.
Beyond the fused-slag rail the ground has a wrong, glassy sheen, and something moves on it.
description: The line where the wastes end and the Redline begins, marked by a slumped rail of fused slag that runs off north and south as far as the haze allows. On this side, the counter ticks. On that side, it screams.
name: The Meltline
